annotations.title: Send a conversion to every ad platform at once

description: Send ONE conversion event (a sale, sign-up, lead or your own event) to EVERY ad platform conversions API the brand saved as a destination, in one call: Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Reddit, Pinterest, X, Microsoft Advertising, ChatGPT Ads, AppLovin and Amazon Ads. Pass PLAIN identifiers: each platform’s sender normalises and SHA-256 hashes them to that platform’s own rules, and every platform receives the same eventId as its dedup key (match it to the browser pixel’s). Click ids in sourceUrl (gclid, fbclid, ttclid, twclid, msclkid, li_fat_id …) are read automatically, and a click id the same person carried on an earlier stored page view rides along with a server-side sale. Each destination answers on its own, read back from what the PLATFORM said (accepted, refused, skipped and why); one failing never blocks another. DRY RUN: validateOnly:true and/or testCode reach only the platforms with a mode that records nothing (Pinterest, Snapchat and ChatGPT Ads validate; TikTok and Reddit take a test code from their Events Manager) and skip the rest by name, so nothing real is counted. Meta keeps events sent with a test code, so a dry run never reaches Meta. forward:false only RECORDS the events (page views and other touches for journeys) and sends them nowhere. Every non-test event is stored with its identifiers hashed, for conversion_insights and campaign_profit. Google Ads is refused by name: Google no longer accepts conversion uploads from new integrations through its Ads API. Free.

carryClickIds.description: false stops click ids from the same person’s earlier page views riding along

destinations.description: send to these instead of the saved ones: saved destination ids, or destination objects shaped like conversion_destinations action add

actionSource.description: where it happened; default web when sourceUrl is given, else other

campaign.description: the ad campaign behind it, when you know it; counts the sale toward that campaign in campaign_profit

consent.description: EU/UK consent signals, forwarded where a platform takes them

adUserData.description: consent to use the person’s data for ads

currency.description: ISO code, e.g. USD; needed with a value

eventId.description: the ONE dedup id every platform receives: your order or lead id, the same one the browser pixel sends

eventName.description: Purchase, Lead, QualifiedLead, CompleteRegistration, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, AddPaymentInfo, Subscribe, StartTrial, ViewContent, Search, Contact, SubmitApplication, Schedule, PageView, AddToWishlist, or your own name

eventTime.description: unix seconds, ms or ISO; default now

limitedDataUse.description: the person opted out of data sale (US state privacy laws)

referrer.description: the referring page, for organic and referral touches

sourceUrl.description: the page URL; its gclid / fbclid / ttclid / utm_* parameters are read

user.description: who converted: send every identifier you have

clickIds.description: ad click ids captured on the landing page: fbc, fbp, gclid, gbraid, wbraid, ttclid, ttp, li_fat_id, epik, rdt_cid, twclid, msclkid, sccid, oppref, aleid, axwrt. Ids in sourceUrl are read automatically

email.description: plain email; each platform hashes it to its own rules on Hermoso’s server, never hash it yourself

externalId.description: your own customer id (CRM / user id)

leadId.description: a Meta or TikTok lead id, for CRM lead events

visitorId.description: your anonymous visitor / cookie id: ties page views to a later sale for journeys and paths

forward.description: false records the events for journeys and sends them nowhere

source.description: where these came from, e.g. crm, shopify, stripe (shown on stored events); default api

testCode.description: dry run for TikTok and Reddit: the test code from their Events Manager

validateOnly.description: dry run: platforms with a validate mode check the events and record nothing; the rest are skipped
